note: The viewer schema is declared by hand because `reward` is a key-bag with seven distinct shapes: the two records in `batch-r01.jsonl` already disagree over `xfailed`, 600 records carry no `buf_breaking` at all, and the rare `ignored` / `skipped` / `disabled` / `pending` keys first appear only in `batch-r02.jsonl`, `batch-r03.jsonl`, `batch-r06.jsonl` and `batch-r12.jsonl`, so a schema inferred from the first shard cannot cast the rest and the parquet index never builds.

struct.name: args
struct.note: always an object; keys differ per tool (`bash`, `read`, `edit`, `write`, `grep`)

list.name: reflection
list.note: present on 2948 of 70670 steps, spread over 1432 of 3414 records

features.name: reward
features.note: key-bag: `success` (bool), `tests_passed` and `cost_steps` (int) on every record, plus `buf_breaking` on 2814 of 3414 records and `xfailed` on 1686 of 3414, and the rare `skipped` (10 records), `ignored` (7), `disabled` (2), `pending` (2)

features.name: meta
features.note: key-bag: `factory`, `generator` (string) and `round` (int) on every record; no other `meta` key occurs in this dataset

disclosures: `reward` shape census over the 3414 published records: 1686 are `{buf_breaking, cost_steps, success, tests_passed, xfailed}`, 1107 drop `xfailed`, 600 drop both `buf_breaking` and `xfailed`, and 21 carry one extra key instead — `skipped` (10), `ignored` (7), `disabled` (2) or `pending` (2). Declaring `reward` as `json` keeps every variant readable without a single historical raw record being rewritten.
Step `reflection` is optional: 2948 of 70670 steps carry it, on 1432 of 3414 records. Every declared field is nullable, so it reads back as `null` on the steps that omit it.

Every record is a `proto-breaking-change-factory` episode generated by `grok-4.6`, with the same seven top-level keys and the same `meta` shape `{factory, generator, round}` on all 3414 records. There is no leftover-mill mix and no dest-stamped foreign payload in this dataset.
Every step publishes a public `decision_basis`. There are no hidden `thought` or `internal_reasoning` fields.
